decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the submitted plans Ag/01, dated 18/10/12, received 11/01/13; Ag/02A, dated 18/10/12, received 11/01/13; Ag/03A, dated 18/10/12, received 11/01/13; Ag/04A, dated 18/10/12, received 11/01/13 approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No.12 Abinger Gardens, Isleworth.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Replacement of garage with a single-storey side extension, external alterations and replacement windows to existing dwelling.
